									69 text Why page-aware assistance matters
								70 text A browser assistant is most useful when its answer is grounded in the page the user chose. Matrx Extend can capture readable content on demand, inspect page structure, and use that context to answer a direct question. Automatic capture is optional and is off on a fresh installation.
